name: @openagt/saved-prompts
description: The prompts a person saved, theirs in every project or one project's: the message box's `/` menu and its Commands menu load one into the box, and “Save prompt…” saves what the box holds as one.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/test-node.mjs && cd dashboard && vitest run
